notes.title: 2 Horsemen, 3 Stages
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

Each stage has a distinct art style, gameplay, and theme. Here’s a breakdown of the stages available for Early Access: 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/6d77f5c7ee4efe6e059001f66300cc605926ba52.png[/img] 
Stage 1 - Desolate desert with image-based puzzles, where the Boy finds hints of the Apocalypse 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/d4c2ca1bb257bda286105da369d8db331b1036aa.png[/img] 
Stage 2 - Shadowed farmland with trap puzzles, where the Boy encounters the White Horseman of Deception 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/0a41240677189002d5477af858b5c72fda8558b2.png[/img] 
Stage 3 - Burning towns with avoidance puzzle, where the Boy flees the Red Horseman of War 

Which stage are you enjoying the most? Which one is the most beautiful? Please share so we can make the next two stages even better!

- The Acts29Games team

notes.title: Lore - Behind the Horsemen
notes.content:
Who are the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse? In the Bible, four riders appear on white, red, black, and pale horses. Artists all interpret the Horsemen differently – they even debate over the exact color of the pale horse! With [i]Diaspora[/i], we've put our own spin on the four riders. 

In Early Access, you'll encounter two Horsemen – Deception and War. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41669227/500cdb90c25525bccbd7de7d80c184187acee02d.jpg[/img]
Deception is the White Rider who mesmerizes people into following false gods. To survive the dreary Deception stage, the protagonist must solve trap puzzles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41669227/9a3fbdf3ef93fc7b124a2006db4bcd502d9808ac.jpg[/img]
War is the Red Rider who incites people to kill and pursue the protagonist. This fiery stage is made of both escape and danger-avoidance puzzles. 

We hope this backstory was helpful! More details will follow. 

- The Acts29Games team

notes.title: Inspirations Behind Diaspora
notes.content:
Hi Everyone, 

You've all been wondering about [i]Diaspora[/i]’s backstory, so we'll share some broad strokes here! 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/ef99ded0cdcc9d6ebdbf1f908e76e381eb119c62.jpg[/img]
As you probably guessed, we wanted to create a game with spiritual or religious themes. Specifically, the Seven Seals of Revelation and the Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse play major roles in [i]Diaspora[/i].

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41669227/c321fe58f9d39a58b3b4dc4331cf3d4ab67bce85.jpg[/img]
Each state’s aesthetic, puzzle type, and themes center around a different Horseman. For example, the Deception stage features trap-based puzzles, while the War stage focuses on danger avoidance. 

Despite the intense subject matter, we didn't want to create another overstimulating title. [i]Diaspora[/i] is intended to impact players without overwhelming them. 

We hope you enjoy learning more about our boy, El the sheep, and this chaotic world! 

- The Acts29Games team
